REQUEST FOR TENDER RFT-2027-014
Digital Literacy Workshop Series for Older Adults
Issued by: Harbourview Municipal Library Board (fictional test organisation)

Background
The Harbourview Municipal Library Board operates seven branch libraries. The Board is procuring a contractor to design and deliver a digital literacy workshop series for residents aged 60 and over across four branches.

Statement of Work
1. Design a 10-module curriculum covering smartphones, online banking safety and video calling.
2. Deliver 40 workshops of 2 hours each between April and September 2027.
3. Provide printed take-home guides in English and French for every participant.
4. Submit a monthly attendance report to the Library Programs Manager.

Bidder Requirements
- Bidders must hold commercial general liability insurance of not less than CAD 2,000,000.
- All facilitators must provide a current police vulnerable sector check before the first workshop.

[[SOURCE: RFT-2027-014_Digital_Literacy.pdf | PAGE: 2]]
Evaluation Criteria
Tenders will be scored out of 100%.
Technical Proposal – 70%
Methodology (50%) - approach to adult learners with limited digital experience.
Team (30%) - facilitator qualifications and bilingual capacity.
Experience (20%) - comparable workshop programmes delivered in the last five years.
Price – 30%

Pricing Schedule
Prices must be quoted in Canadian dollars as a fixed price per workshop, exclusive of HST.
The total contract value shall not exceed CAD 45,000.

Payment Terms
Invoices are payable net 30 days after acceptance of each monthly attendance report.

Submission Instructions
Tenders must be submitted through the Board's e-tendering portal no later than 2:00 p.m. on March 15, 2027.
Late tenders will not be accepted.
